title: Easy Cheesy Veggie Taco Bake
subtitle: with Capsicum and Corn
description: Grow your little ones’ love for food with our new recipes that bring fun and yum to dinnertime! We've included a rainbow of veggies plus belly-filling kidney beans in these delicious family-friendly tacos.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Grease a 2L (8 cup) baking dish. Discard the husk and silks from the corn, then slice the kernels from the cob. Cut the capsicum and tomatoes into 1cm chunks. Coarsely grate the cheese. Drain and rinse the beans.

Start filling: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the corn, capsicum and Tex-Mex seasoning, stirring, for 4 mins or until charred. Add the tomato and 2 tbs tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until the tomato is softened.

Simmer filling: Add the beans, 2 tsp soy sauce and 80ml (⅓ cup) water to the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 mins until thickened. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Assemble and bake tacos: Divide the bean mixture among the tortillas. Fold in half, then stack upright in the baking dish. Scatter over the cheese and season with salt and pepper. Bake for 10 mins or until the cheese is melted and the tacos are warmed through.
Serve up: Drizzle the tacos with the tomato sauce, divide among plates and enjoy!

Eat the rainbow: Take the challenge and eat the rainbow! Eating a colourful and varied diet will give your body the mix of nutrients it needs. Ask the kids to list all the colours they can see in their tacos. What other 'colours' have they eaten today?
